name: refly
title_zh: 把工作流变成可发现、可运行的领域技能
tagline_zh: 当你的技能散落在各个目录、每次调用都要翻文档时，Refly 用符号链接把意图路由到对的技能，并交给后端执行。
tagline_en: Skills scattered, docs to dig? Refly symlinks intent to the right domain skill and runs it on the backend.
desc_en: Base skill for Refly ecosystem: creates, discovers, and runs domain-specific skills bound to workflows. Routes user intent to matching domain skills via symlinks, delegates execution to Refly backend. Use when user asks to: create skills, run workflows, automate multi-step tasks, or manage pipelines. Triggers: refly, skill, workflow, run skill, create skill, automation, pipeline. Requires: @refly/
why_zh: 它不只是一个技能，而是技能生态的底座：创建、发现、运行、路由一体，让多步自动化像点菜单一样被调度。
why_en: Not a skill but the ecosystem's backbone: create, discover, run, and route—multi-step automation becomes a menu.
limit_zh: 只服务 Refly 生态：本机需装 @refly/ 依赖，且技能必须绑定到已有工作流。脱离 Refly 后端。
limit_en: Refly-only: needs @refly/ deps and workflow-bound skills. Outside its backend, it's just a symlink mover—no standalone output.
